description: Synthetic boundary-condition points for Web Mercator latitude limit testing.  Points are placed at the exact limit (WEB_MERCATOR_LAT_LIMIT = 85.05112877980659°), 0.001° inside, 0.001° outside, and at the poles (±90°), plus antimeridian points at ±180° longitude and near-corner points at (±179.999°, ±84.999°).  Features labelled *_outside and *_deep_outside lie entirely outside the Web Mercator tile extent and are expected to be excluded from the archive with a UserWarning.
